business_problem: Goodiebox had to plan monthly subscription boxes across thousands of customers, many brands, changing trends, stock levels, and expiry dates, but spreadsheet-heavy planning could not scale without creating waste, slow decisions, and error-prone logistics work.
solution_summary: Goodiebox worked with IBM Business Partner Integrator and IBM Client Engineering to replace spreadsheet-driven box planning with an optimization and analytics workflow built on IBM Decision Optimization CPLEX, IBM Watson Studio Heritage, IBM Watson Machine Learning, and IBM Cloud services. After a business-framing exercise and MVP, the team created a data model that ingests stock data, expiry dates, and business rules, recommends product combinations for each monthly box, shows planners how changes affect inventory, and reserves items for current or future boxes. The solution combines optimization logic with what-if analysis so Goodiebox can balance creative merchandising decisions against waste reduction, inventory constraints, and downstream ecommerce performance. IBM Cloud services and supporting storage/data tooling give the team a scalable environment for iterating on the model with real-world data, which lets Goodiebox make better monthly decisions while retaining flexibility to tune the experience by country, segment, and purchase behavior.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Studio Heritage
solution_components.role: Supports the data-modeling work used to build and refine the monthly planning solution.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Machine Learning

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud environment for the optimization workflow and associated user experience.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Object Storage
solution_components.role: Stores the data assets used to run box-planning and inventory scenarios.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Pak for Data

data_flow: Inventory, expiry-date, and business-rule data flow into the optimization model, CPLEX and supporting Watson components generate candidate box mixes and scenario analyses, planners adjust the recommendations through the interface, and the resulting selections reserve inventory for current and future subscription boxes.
business_outcome: Goodiebox cut per-box cost, reduced waste and manual effort, and accelerated monthly planning so teams could spend more time on creative curation while making better inventory and assortment decisions.
